subject: Annual packaging & PO constraints — Nimbus Health
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@nimbushealth.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: pricing structure & PO constraints for enterprise purchase

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick intro call last week. Procurement asked me to follow up with a couple of constraints before we can progress:

- Nimbus will issue separate purchase orders per legal entity (we have three) and often per business unit; we cannot combine them into a single PO.
- Standard payment term we must request is Net 60; finance will consider Net 45 only with early-pay incentives.
- Invoicing cadence: procurement prefers quarterly invoices for corporate consolidation, but they also need monthly usage detail for cost centers.

Could Redwood support multiple POs that tie back to one master agreement, and provide a bucketed pricing workbook that maps commitment tiers to unit price? Also please indicate how invoice numbering and references would work if we receive multiple POs.

Attaching procurement's short questionnaire for reference.

Thanks,
Ellen
Ellen Park
Sr. Procurement Manager
Nimbus Health

Attachment: procurement_questionnaire.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: pricing structure & PO constraints for enterprise purchase

Hi Ellen — great to hear. Short answers up front:

- We can accept multiple POs tied to a single master agreement. We typically require each PO to reference the master agreement number so invoices can be reconciled.
- Net terms: our standard enterprise offering is Net 45; for Net 60 we'd need to layer a finance approval and evaluate credit exposure. We can offer a 1.5% discount for Net 30 / 2% for 30-day early payment if that helps.
- Invoicing cadence: quarterly invoices are fine. We'll include a monthly usage breakdown per legal entity on the invoice PDF.

I'll drop a "pricing buckets" workbook for you to review — it shows tiered per-token pricing with breakpoints for committed monthly and annual consumption. Ben (CC'd) will propose a concrete bucket that maps to your three legal entities.

Proposed next step: 30-minute cadence with procurement and finance to confirm PO reference fields and sample invoice templates. Are you available Wed 14th 10–11am PT?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_Pricing_Buckets_2026.xlsx (xlsx stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@nimbushealth.com>, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: pricing structure & PO constraints for enterprise purchase

Ellen — thanks. A couple of concrete proposals so we can move quickly:

Option A — Master bucket with per-entity POs:
- Nimbus signs a single master agreement (master PO number in the contract).
- Each legal entity submits its own PO that references the master PO. Invoices are issued per PO (per entity) or aggregated into quarterly rolls, per your request.
- Pricing: bucketed consumption (monthly committed tiers). Volume discount kicks in at 50k tokens/mo (5%), 200k tokens/mo (12%).

Option B — Consolidated billing with sub-ledger mapping:
- Redwood issues one quarterly invoice referencing the master PO; we attach a CSV that maps line items back to your entity POs for ERP ingestion.
- This avoids multiple invoice documents but still satisfies your AP system mapping.

Finance note (Vivek): We'll need a reconciliation field — we propose 'MasterAgreementID' and 'EntityPO' in invoice line metadata. Accepting Net 60 will need approval from Finance and Credit; Net 45 is doable without escalation.

I've also uploaded a draft SOW that includes language to accept multiple POs per master agreement and a sample invoice file. If you can confirm which option you'd prefer we'll prepare contract language.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_multipo_clause_v1.pdf (pdf stub), Invoice_mapping_template.xlsx (xlsx stub)

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@nimbushealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@nimbushealth.com>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 07:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: pricing structure & PO constraints for enterprise purchase

Ben/Vanessa — Thanks for the clear options. Procurement's constraints are firm:

- We must issue separate POs per legal entity. We can include a MasterAgreementID field in each PO but our AP system will still ingest separate invoices per entity.
- Invoicing cadence: procurement prefers quarterly invoices, but each invoice must be attributed to the entity PO number.
- Payment terms: Net 60 is our standard; we will consider Net 45 with a 1.5% early-pay (30 days) incentive. A 2% incentive for 15 days would be even better.

If Redwood can do Option A (per-entity invoices referencing the master agreement) and provide a monthly CSV with line-level usage per entity, procurement will sign. Can you confirm the exact metadata fields you will populate on each invoice (MasterAgreementID, EntityPO, UsageBucket, InvoicePeriod)? Also please include contact info for AR so we can do an ERP test ingest on a dummy invoice.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Sr. Procurement Manager
Nimbus Health

On Mon, Apr 13, 2026 at 10:42 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Ellen — thanks. A couple of concrete proposals so we can move quickly: ...

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: pricing structure & PO constraints for enterprise purchase

Ellen — summary and next steps:

Agreements:
- Redwood will accept multiple POs (one per legal entity). Each PO must include the MasterAgreementID which we'll put on every invoice line.
- Redwood will issue invoices per entity (Option A) on a quarterly cadence and will attach a monthly usage CSV that includes: MasterAgreementID, EntityPO, UsageBucket, InvoicePeriod, TokenCount, UnitPrice, LineTotal.
- Standard enterprise payment term offered: Net 45. We will include a 2% early-pay discount if payment is received within 30 days. (We will route a Net 60 request to Finance but cannot commit without a credit review.)

Attachments: I've attached the SOW with the multiple-PO clause and the invoice mapping template. AR contact for test ingest: accounts.receivable@redwood.com (attn: Vivek Kulkarni).

Next steps:
1) Ellen — confirm acceptance of the above and which of the three legal entities wants to pilot a dummy invoice for ERP testing.
2) Ben/Marissa — draft amendment with MasterAgreementID clause and early-pay discount language; route to legal for approval.
3) Procurement call: Wed 14th 10am PT — we'll use this to confirm fields and run the dummy ingest.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_multipo_clause_v1.pdf, Invoice_mapping_template.xlsx
